identity.authorization: AI Studio access runtime remains authoritative for the optional full-admin return control; verification failure hides the control.
identity.session: AI Akademie does not transfer access tokens, permits or session capabilities between applications.

operations: same-origin dynamic import of AI Studio access control
requestApiAi.aiPolicy: No LLM, model provider or external AI API is called by the AI Akademie runtime.

egress.defaultDeny: Cross-origin application egress is not declared; the architecture gate rejects undeclared network capability.

files.currentBoundary: Runtime exposes no user-file upload, import, parsing or transformation path.

dataLifecycle.storage: localStorage is limited to quiz, checklist and UI state; the service worker uses network-only/no-store for application runtime.
dataLifecycle.retention: No server-side application data store is present in the current static deployment profile.

release.promotion: candidate -> P5/GARP/N5 -> trusted admission -> protected main -> verified Pages deploy
release.rollback: GARP 2.5.1, N5 and Safe Promotion remain retained regression controls; no second runtime security engine is introduced.

inventory.changeRule: Capability or runtime-source changes require architecture-integrity revalidation.

securityHealth.localCi: Reference integrity, policy admission, architecture integrity, mutation tests and trusted-admission selftests are required.
securityHealth.live: NOT_TESTED while the school-server phase remains deferred.
securityHealth.failureMode: Admission fails closed when required local or CI evidence is missing or fails.

incident.response: Block promotion on failed security gates, preserve evidence and require a clean candidate before retry.

recovery.current: Return to a previously verified clean candidate or produce a new candidate that passes the complete release chain.
recovery.future: School-server recovery controls remain DEFERRED_BY_OWNER_DECISION until that phase is approved.
